name: Wenxiang Qian
biography: Wenxiang Qian is a senior security researcher at the Tencent Blade Team. He is focusing on security research of IoT devices. He also do security audits for web browsers. He was on the top 100 of annual MSRC list (2016 & 2017 ). He published a book called "Whitehat Talk About Web Browser Security ". Twitter: @leonwxqian
